research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Aviron Interactive is researching and developing an adjustable foot plate for rowing machines, as described in the title 'Adjustable foot plate for rowing machines.' The abstract details a foot plate with two platforms, each featuring a strap, heel counter, and a lengthening member to adjust the distance between the strap and heel counter, enhancing user customization during rowing. This area of research and development focuses on improving the ergonomics and adaptability of rowing machine components.

Short, high-intensity workouts save time, high resistance settings allow to include strength training along with cardio workout, and hundreds of content options to get motivated and keep engaged month after month.

about_short_description.short_description: Aviron Interactive is a fitness company offering a rower with gamification features.

product.name: Aviron Impact Series Rower
product.description: An interactive rowing machine with a 22" HD touchscreen, dual air and magnetic resistance, adjustable foot pads, and ergonomic design for full-body workouts.

product.name: Aviron Strong Series Rower
product.description: A rowing machine with a 20" HD touchscreen, higher weight capacity, adjustable foot pads, and ergonomic features for interactive full-body workouts.

product.name: Aviron Fit Bike
product.description: A stationary indoor bike with a 22" HD touchscreen, electromagnetic resistance, freewheel design, and adjustable components for interactive cycling workouts.

product.name: Aviron Play Headphones
product.description: Wireless, sweat-proof headphones using air conduction technology designed for comfort and ambient sound during workouts.
